text: A rare 5.0-magnitude earthquake struck Spain’s tourist hotspot Granada shortly after 1:00 am, damaging buildings and prompting hundreds of emergency calls. Officials reported no casualties or serious damage, including at the UNESCO-listed Alhambra palace.#Spain#Granada
